item.title: Blocked drain cnr Eden Pk Ave and Glainfield Rd, 20th August
item.description:
Water not running away into drain after a small amount of rain fall. Blocked drain in Glanfield Road side of 127 Eden Park Ave. Water is half way across the road and also over the dropped kerb. Please could a Gulley Sucker be sent out to clear the drain. This corner always floods when it rains, even in light rain. Surface water above the drain is still the same for the last 90 minutes and is not draining away. This has been reported many times before and was supposed to be fixed, which it has not been as you can see from the photo.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Glanfield Road, Upper Elmers End, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Overhanging crab apple trees, 20th August
item.description:
There are two large crabapple trees at the rear of my garden which are packed with apples and obstructing my light. I have four small grandchildren who are limited to play in the garden due to apples falling all the time. These trees need cutting back as they are having an impact on my family enjoying the garden and the lack of light. My grandchildren are at risk from these falling apples as the tree is laden. Please could these trees be cut back as they are overhanging my garden.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Roberts Road, Lessness Heath, Greater London
